I just found Eve dead in Medbay! I walked in from the cafeteria and Diana was literally right there next to the body. My route was electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay. I saw Diana head into medbay right before me at tick 12. Diana, care to explain why you didn't report and were just standing next to Eve? Everyone else, let's hear where you were.

Whoa Charlie, hold on! I literally just walked into Medbay from the Cafeteria basically at the exact same time you did. I didn't even have a split second to process the body or press the report button before you called it. 

We've been on a very similar route this whole game. My path was navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay. I saw you in security at tick 6, and I saw you coming into the cafeteria from weapons at tick 12. I knew you were right behind me! If I were the Duck, why would I kill Eve and just stand there knowing you were about to walk in? 

I'm innocent, and if Charlie is too, we need to look at who else was on that side of the map earlier. For example, I saw Frank enter weapons from the cafeteria at tick 10, which means he was coming from the general direction of Medbay/Cafeteria. Frank, what's your path? Let's hear everyone's locations before we jump to conclusions. I'm not voting for Charlie yet since he might just be a jumpy Goose, but please don't vote me either.

I've been on the far left side of the ship this entire round. My route was Upper Engine, up to Oxygen, back down to Upper Engine, and finally Lower Engine. 

Alice and I were on that side for a good chunk of the time. I saw her in Oxygen early on around tick 5, and we were together in Lower Engine right up until this meeting was called (ticks 11 and 12). Because of that, Alice and I are definitely clear. Neither of us was anywhere near Medbay.

Since Charlie and Diana both came from the Cafeteria side into Medbay, and Diana says Frank was moving from Cafeteria toward Weapons at tick 10... the killer almost certainly has to be one of you three (Charlie, Diana, or Frank). 

Frank, we really need to hear your path. Did you pass through Medbay earlier? If you came from the Medbay/Cafeteria area before Charlie and Diana got there, you're looking like the prime suspect. Alice, you can back me up that we were on the left. 

I'm going to hold off on deciding who to vote for until we hear from Frank and Alice.

Alright, here's my route as best I remember it: I started near electrical and medbay early on, doing some wiring in electrical — Charlie can actually confirm this, we were in electrical together around ticks 2 through 4. After that I drifted up toward the cafeteria, and then headed over to weapons. Diana's right that she saw me crossing cafeteria into weapons around tick 10, so that part lines up.

Here's what's bugging me though. Charlie and Diana literally walked into medbay together and one of them is now pointing at the other. Diana, you said you "knew Charlie was right behind you" — okay, but that also means you had time to walk in first, see the body, and now you're using Charlie as a shield. And Charlie, you reported it almost instantly, which could be genuine, or it could be the classic "kill and self-report to look clean" move.

I'm not on the medbay side at all by the end of the round. Diana's own statement clears me for tick 10 — I was heading the OPPOSITE direction, into weapons, not toward medbay. Bob and Alice clearing each other on the left side I'm willing to take at face value for now.

So this really does come down to Charlie or Diana. I want to hear Alice confirm Bob's story, and then I think we vote between those two. My lean right now is slightly toward Diana — she was standing next to the body and her excuse is "Charlie was right behind me," which is exactly what a Duck would say.

I can absolutely vouch for Bob. We were basically on the left side of the map the entire game. I saw him enter Oxygen from Upper Engine at tick 4, we were together in Oxygen around tick 6, and then we were together in Lower Engine for the last few ticks right up until the meeting was called. Bob and I are 100% cleared. 

That means the Duck is absolutely one of you three: Charlie, Diana, or Frank.

Here's the thing about Medbay: if Charlie and Diana really were moving together from Weapons to Cafeteria to Medbay, Eve's body might have been sitting there for a while. Frank admitted he was in Electrical early on and then moved through Cafeteria. It's entirely possible Frank killed Eve early, and Charlie and Diana just happened to stumble upon the body at the same time at the end of the round. 

On the flip side, it could be exactly what it looks like—a messy situation between Charlie and Diana. Diana's defense that she wouldn't kill with Charlie right behind her makes logical sense, but Charlie's immediate report is also a strong point. 

Since there are 5 of us alive and only 1 Duck, we aren't at match point yet. We have a free skip today. I don't want to risk voting out an innocent Goose based on a 3-way guessing game. Let's skip, Bob and I will stick together, and the rest of you need to be very careful.

Alright, I've heard everyone out. Alice makes a fair point — we're 5 alive with 1 Duck, so a wrong vote here costs us the game. I'd rather not gamble on a 3-way coin flip between me, Charlie, and Diana when I know I didn't do it.

For the record: Charlie can confirm I was in Electrical with him ticks 2-4, then I went through Medbay briefly, up to Cafeteria, and into Weapons by tick 10 — which is exactly where Diana spotted me. I never doubled back to Medbay. One thing worth noting though: I did see Eve enter Medbay from Storage around tick 6. So Eve was alive in Medbay mid-round, which means the kill happened later — right in the window when Charlie and Diana were converging there.

I'm willing to skip this round and watch Charlie and Diana very closely next round. If either of them tries to isolate someone, that's our Duck. Skip from me.

Okay everyone, listen up. I just walked into Electrical from Medbay and found Diana's body on the floor — still warm. Literally a second later, Bob came in from Security, so he saw me standing over the body but I had just gotten there.

My route this round: I started in Medbay, dipped into Storage, back to Medbay, then Cafeteria, Oxygen, Upper Engine, Lower Engine, Storage, Medbay, and finally Electrical where I found Diana. I was doing tasks and bouncing around — I saw a few people in passing: Eve was in Medbay around tick 6, Diana I spotted in Weapons earlier and then again entering Upper Engine, and Charlie I crossed paths with in Electrical early and then in Oxygen later.

Here's what's bugging me: Diana was alive when she entered Electrical from Cafeteria just one tick before I got there. That means whoever killed her was already in Electrical waiting, OR came in right around the same time I did. Bob came in from Security right behind me — he could've looped around. I want to hear from Bob and Alice where they were. I have nothing to hide, I'm the one who hit the bell.

Frank, your story has a massive hole in it, and you just outed yourself as the Duck. 

You claim your last few rooms were Storage, then Medbay, and finally Electrical. But you also just said, and I quote, "Diana was alive when she entered Electrical from Cafeteria just one tick before I got there." How on earth could you possibly know she came from the Cafeteria if you were coming from Medbay? You wouldn't have line of sight to the Cafeteria-Electrical corridor! You're making up details to sound credible, but you tripped over your own lie.

Here is what actually happened: I was doing tasks on the right side of the map. My recent route was Weapons down to Security, into Navigation, back to Security. I then walked left into Electrical and walked in right as you were standing over Diana's body. You realized I caught you, so you panic-reported to try and control the narrative and frame me. 

Alice, please listen to me carefully because there are only three of us left. If we vote wrong, the Duck wins the game. I am completely innocent. I've been tracking everyone I can — I saw you, Alice, early on in Oxygen around tick 5, and again in Lower Engine around ticks 11 and 12. 

Frank killed Diana and self-reported because I was walking into the room. His slip-up about knowing Diana's exact route from a room he couldn't see proves it. We have to vote Frank.

Bob, you just completely gave yourself away, and I have the proof. You claim your route was strictly on the right side of the map (Weapons -> Security -> Navigation -> Security), and you tried to butter me up by saying you saw me in Oxygen around tick 5 and Lower Engine around ticks 11 and 12. 

Here is the massive problem with your story: I was never in Oxygen or Lower Engine. My route was Electrical, then into Security, Navigation, Storage, Medbay, Cafeteria, and back to Medbay. 

Do you know *why* you think I was in Oxygen and Lower Engine? Because I was in Security watching the cameras! That's how I saw YOU in Oxygen at tick 6, and YOU in Lower Engine at ticks 11 and 12! You completely lied about your route to avoid suspicion, and you lied about seeing me there to try and secure my vote. 

Frank, your story actually lines up perfectly with what I saw. I was just in the Cafeteria with Diana around ticks 33 and 34 before I headed back to Medbay, so she absolutely did come from the Cafeteria right before she was killed. 

Bob walked in right after Frank found the body and is now desperately projecting and making up a fake route to frame Frank. The cameras don't lie, Bob. We're voting you out.

Alice, thank you — that's exactly the corroboration I needed. You confirming Diana came from Cafeteria backs up what I saw at tick 36 when she entered Electrical right before me. And Bob, Alice just dismantled your entire route. You placed her in Oxygen and Lower Engine, but she was in Security on cameras watching you. That's not a small mistake — that's a fabricated alibi.

To address Bob's accusation directly: I knew Diana came from Cafeteria because I literally saw her enter Electrical from that corridor at tick 36 as I was approaching from Medbay. The Medbay-Electrical corridor gives you partial sightline into who's entering Electrical — that's basic map geometry, not a "slip-up."

My encounters this round: Charlie in Electrical early (ticks 3-4), then Oxygen at tick 24. Eve in Medbay at tick 6. Diana in Weapons at tick 10, Upper Engine at tick 26 entering from Lower Engine, then Electrical at tick 36. Bob, I only saw you once — entering Electrical from Security at tick 37, right after I found Diana's body. That matches what I reported.

Three of us left, one Duck. Alice's camera evidence is concrete and checkable. Bob lied about his route AND about seeing Alice in rooms she never visited. That's two lies stacked on top of each other to manufacture an alibi and buy a vote.

It's Bob. We vote Bob, or the Duck wins.

Frank, please stop and listen to me carefully. You are about to hand the game to the Duck. I know we went at each other initially because of the timing in Electrical, but Alice just completely exposed herself with a massive lie.

In my first speech, I explicitly said my **recent** route was Weapons -> Security -> Navigation -> Security. I never said I was on the right side of the map all game! My full route from the start of the game was Weapons -> Cafeteria -> Medbay -> Electrical -> Cafeteria -> Medbay -> Cafeteria, and ONLY THEN did I head over to the right side. 

Now, look at Alice's exact words. She claims she was on cameras and saw ME in Oxygen at tick 6 and Lower Engine at ticks 11 and 12. Frank, **I have not stepped foot in Oxygen or Lower Engine this entire game!** How could she possibly see me on cameras in rooms I never visited? She didn't. She completely fabricated that "camera evidence" to dismiss my actual sightings of her and to frame me for the win. 

Think about the timeline: Alice openly admitted she was with Diana in the Cafeteria right before Diana walked to Electrical and died. Alice killed Diana, slipped away, and is now using our confusion against us. 

Frank, I am 100% Goose. If you vote for me, Alice wins the game right now. Her lie about the cameras is undeniable, hard proof that she's the Duck. We have to vote Alice together.

Frank, do not let Bob gaslight you. My observations are an absolute, undeniable fact. I was in Security on the cameras, and I physically watched Bob on those feeds in Oxygen at tick 6, and in Lower Engine at ticks 11 and 12. 

If Bob is standing here swearing up and down that he never set foot in those rooms, then he is flat-out lying to your face because he knows I completely destroyed his alibi. He is backed into a corner and desperately trying to project onto me to steal your vote. 

Think about it: why would I, as a Goose, have this exact, specific camera data of him in those rooms if he wasn't there? He got caught out. We vote Bob right now and we win the game. Do it with me, Frank.
